sources.title: LiquidAI/LFM3-1.7B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: LFM3-1.7B is a text model for local agents and specialized applications, based on our new tri-hybrid architecture.

sources.title: Introducing LFM3: Every Modality for Specialized Intelligence | ...
sources.snippet: Training. LFM3-1.7B-Base was pre-trained on 22T tokens. Compared with LFM2, the mix adds more scientific papers, repository-level code, a wider range of knowledge sources, and considerably more math. The final 3.5T tokens are a mid-training stage on curated, higher-quality data, with a larger share of agentic traces and diverse tool calls to prepare the model for agentic post-training.

sources.snippet: According to the LFM3-1.7B model card, the text model has 1.73B parameters, a 256K-token context length, a 128,000-token vocabulary, and support for 16 languages, and it ships under the LFM Open License v1.0.
